# llms.txt — guidance for LLM crawlers (community convention)
# Version: 1.0
# Updated: 2025-09-21

# Discovery
Sitemap: /sitemap.xml

# Ownership & contact
Owner: Dzmitry Drynau
Contact: support@gdhub.io

# Application
App-Name: GDHub
App-Description: Collaborative platform for indie teams to build projects, manage vacancies, run events, publish devlogs, and connect with mentors.
App-Languages: en, ru
App-Topics: startups, indie, hiring, mentoring, events, devlog, product, saas

# Pages overview
Page: / — Home — Overview of the platform, featured projects, events, and blog highlights.
Page: /projects — Projects directory — filters and navigation to individual project pages.
Page: /project/{slug} — Project — summary, team, reports, and open vacancies.
Page: /vacancies — Open positions across teams and projects.
Page: /events — Events list — upcoming and archived events.
Page: /event/{slug} — Event — description, schedule, and participation details.
Page: /blog — Articles and news from the community.
Page: /blog/{slug} — Blog post — full article content.
Page: /hub — Community hub — access to projects, members, mentors, and resources.
Page: /hub/projects — Public projects board with filters.
Page: /hub/members — Members directory with profiles.
Page: /hub/mentors — Mentors directory.
Page: /devlog/{projectReportId} — Public project devlog post.
Page: /cookie-policy — Cookies usage policy.
Page: /registration — User registration page.

# Usage policy (non-binding but explicit intent)
# - Summarization of Allowed pages is permitted with attribution
# - Long-form wholesale reproduction is not permitted
# - Model training on Disallowed areas is prohibited
# - Respect rate limits and crawl delay
Data-Use: allow-summarization, allow-short-snippets, disallow-training-on-disallowed
Attribution: required
Attribution-URL: /
Content-License: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
Commercial-Use: no
Derived-Works: no

# Rate limits for AI crawlers (please respect)
Rate-Limit: 10 req/min
Crawl-Delay: 10

# Allowed human-facing routes (patterns)
Allow: /
Allow: /blog
Allow: /blog/*
Allow: /events
Allow: /event/*
Allow: /projects
Allow: /project/*
Allow: /hub
Allow: /hub/*
Allow: /vacancies
Allow: /devlog/*
Allow: /cookie-policy
Allow: /registration
Allow: /sitemap.xml
Allow: /robots.txt

# Restricted/sensitive areas and non-user pages
Disallow: /api/*
Disallow: /admin/*
Disallow: /my/*
Disallow: /profile/*
Disallow: /live/*
Disallow: /invite/*
Disallow: /signin
Disallow: /_next/*
Disallow: /legal-details

# Bot identifiers (informational; follow robots.txt for enforcement)
User-Agent: GPTBot
User-Agent: ChatGPT-User
User-Agent: OpenAI-User
User-Agent: ClaudeBot
User-Agent: Claude-Web
User-Agent: Google-Extended
User-Agent: GoogleOther
User-Agent: PerplexityBot
User-Agent: Applebot-Extended
User-Agent: CCBot

# Source of truth
Source: Human-authored content under Allowed routes is canonical.
Data-Freshness: Prefer discovery via Sitemap and respect caching headers.
